remarks: Highest and Best Offers due tomorrow, Tuesday, 3/3/26, by 10am. Turnkey Living in Desirable Riverwood at Oenoke! Welcome to easy living in this beautifully maintained detached single-family home, ideally situated in the sought-after Riverwood complex in the quiet Springdale neighborhood. This turnkey residence features an inviting open floor plan with soaring vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and seamless access to a large private deck-perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors overlooking a running stream.  The second floor offers two spacious bedrooms, including a primary suite with generous closet space and a full bath. A versatile loft provides the flexibility to create a third bedroom, home office, or cozy reading retreat.  Enjoy low common charges of just $240/month, 1 car attached garage, ample guest parking, and a convenient location close to shopping, dining, transportation, and the Merritt Parkway. With nearby parks, playgrounds, and Springdale's vibrant amenities, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. Move right in and start enjoying everything this exceptional home has to offer!
